note: Marks keyed by the `glyph` field in amenities.json. These EXTEND the portal's built-in set (globe, people, book, radio, tv, clock, link); a key present in both wins here, so a shipped mark can be corrected without a reflash. The portal caps the set (count, per-glyph bytes) and rejects any glyph carrying a script tag, an on* handler or a javascript: URL before it renders one.
